jobs.title: Client Associate
jobs.description:
Are you organized, detail oriented, and enjoy working with clients? Do you take pride in following through and keeping things on track? We’re looking for a Client Associate to support our financial advisors and deliver an excellent client experience.
As a Client Associate, you’ll be a key part of our wealth management team—handling client communications, coordinating daily operations, and helping ensure everything runs smoothly behind the scenes.
Key Responsibilities:
• Answer and screen incoming calls for the team
• Manage calendars, including conference calls, vacations, and client meetings
• Handle administrative and operational tasks; escalate items to the appropriate team member when needed
• Follow up to ensure tasks are completed accurately and on time
• Assist with finance related tasks, including invoices and expense reports
• Answer and manage emails in a professional and timely manner
• Prepare, organize, and maintain documents, reports, and records
• Support internal and external communications
• Assist with special projects as assigned
• Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately

• manage review of various supervision processes
• drive initiatives related to sales supervision, compliance and business risk, including implementation and education
• support branches in the Branch Review and Group Internal Audit processes, visiting branches, and working on action plans for those with failed audits
• partner with Compliance, including providing input to policy and supporting communication of policies
• serve as a point of contact for issues that cannot be resolved, and escalate issues as required

jobs.title: Tax Specialist - Regulatory
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about global tax regulation and regulatory change? Do you enjoy working at the intersection of tax expertise, business strategy and international collaboration?

We are looking for Tax Specialist to:

• lead tax regulatory change programs across the UBS Asset Management division globally. This requires a tax specialist with regulatory and change management experience, and monitor any tax developments which will have an impact on the Asset Management division and take the lead on driving implementation, working with the relevant functional regulatory change teams.
• manage and direct the appointment of external advisors if required in relation to tax regulatory change programs, and assist in any regulatory projects where a tax expert is required (e.g. BEPS, ATAD 3, TRACE, FATCA, CRS, CARF, s871m, US PTP, Financial Transaction Tax).
• lead AM cross border tax advisory and control support for the UBS Asset Management division globally, and ensure that the AM business adhere to the Group Tax policies and supplements.
• build and maintain relationships with senior management and UBS Group stakeholders to establish and communicate tax priorities based on changing regulatory environments.
• engage the business in tax regulatory matters, reconciling the competing imperatives of the management of tax risk with commercial and regulatory drivers of the business, and provide the business with regular updates and training on tax and regulatory developments.
• build and maintain relationships with UBS Group functions (e.g. Finance/Legal) and other UBS divisions (Investment Bank and Wealth Management).

Vous appréciez travailler dans un environnement dynamique et stimulant où les objectifs vous motivent ? Do you want to design and build attractive digital products and services? Do you want to play a key role in transforming our firm into an agile organization?

We’re building modern, secure, and elegant digital products for our Wealth Management business users. • Write and maintain tests (unit, integration, and end-to-end) to improve code coverage.
• Guide and mentor team members through code reviews and knowledge sharing.
• Troubleshoot and resolve frontend issues promptly, proposing effective solutions.
• Advocate for client needs and ensure user-centric design in all deliverables.
• Contribute to engineering culture and internal communities.

jobs.title: Team Administrator
jobs.description:
The Team Administrator will lead operational, client service, and administrative functions for a high-performing financial advisor team serving ultra-high-net-worth clients. This individual serves as the operational backbone of the team—ensuring exceptional execution, leading risk and compliance initiatives, and a seamless client experience. The ideal candidate is a seasoned and decisive operations professional with deep knowledge of wealth management processes, strong leadership capabilities, an ability to navigate firm processes efficiently, and who can drive innovation with a technology-forward mindset.

We’re looking for a strong operational leader to manage:

• Operational Leadership & Execution: Act as the primary owner of operational execution, controls, and risk management for our advisory team, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to regulatory and firm standards. Establish, refine, and enforce operational workflows, controls, and best practices in a fast-paced environment and manage daily operational priorities while balancing long-term process improvement initiatives

• Client Service & Relationship Support: Deliver white-glove service for ultra-high-net-worth individuals and family offices with complex financial structures, partnering closely with the financial advisors to anticipate client needs and act discretion and responsiveness.

• Account Administration & Transactions: Oversee and execute a range of important administrative tasks including account openings, account maintenance, and transfers across multiple account types and entities, wires, disbursements, journals, and cash movements with precision and appropriate controls. Ensure timely and accurate processing of all client account paperwork

• Compliance, Risk & Documentation - Manage Know Your Client (KYC), AML, Reg BI and related compliance requirements across the client base ensuring all documentation, approvals, and supervisory processes meet regulatory and firm standards along with adherence to FINRA, SEC, and firm supervisory policies and procedures. Maintain strong controls around sensitive transactions and client data and partner effectively with compliance, legal, risk, and surveillance teams to address inquiries and reviews

• Team Leadership & Development: Manage and develop operations and client service team members including setting priorities, workflow standards, and performance expectations for the operations team. Build a high accountability culture focused on excellence, efficiency, and client satisfaction and lead by example in a dynamic, high-expectation, in-office team environment

• Technology, Systems & Innovation: Serve as the team’s operations technology lead, with strong knowledge of platforms, systems, and workflows. Be the team champion for implementing firm-approved tools, platforms, and AI-driven solutions to drive efficiency, reduce risk, and enhance client experience

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of capital markets through Digital Assets and Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT)? Do you want to help define and scale regulated, institutional digital asset products and services across a global Investment Bank? We’re looking for a Director level Product Manager to join the IB Digital Assets (Products & Services) team. In this role, you will shape and deliver the Investment Bank’s digital assets agenda, translating the potential of digital assets and DLT-based business models into scalable products, services, and business models embedded within and alongside core IB businesses.

We’re looking for a Digital Assets-focused Product Manager to:

• act as end to end Product Manager for defined Digital Assets products, services, and DLT based business models across the Investment Bank
• own the pipeline and roadmap for assigned Digital Assets products, services, and business models, from ideation and prioritisation through to pilot/MVP execution and handover to Change SMEs for scaling and BAU adoption
• originate, structure, and progress business cases for IB Digital Assets pilots and MVPs, including value proposition, economics, risks, dependencies, and success metrics
• partner closely with Front Office, Financing, Risk, Operations, Legal, Compliance, and Technology to enable IB Digital Assets pilots/MVPs in existing IB workflows and operating models
• evaluate internal and external digital/DLT capabilities to determine optimal build, buy, partner, or reuse strategies based on feasibility, maturity, cost, and time to market
• appraise future state IB business and operating models required to scale Digital Assets products and services within IB and Group control frameworks
• act as a senior point of contact and thought partner, engaging internal stakeholders and selected external participants to shape IB positioning, partnerships, and market developments

jobs.title: Investment Banker, M&A
jobs.description:
Are you a problem solver? Do you know how to treat clients? We’re looking for someone like that who can:

• provide transactional advisory services and analyses in connection with mergers and acquisitions on behalf of clients in global markets.
• manage and lead day-to-day transactions, executions, negotiations and client liaisons.
• develop and maintain relationships with key business leaders to identify new opportunities for advisory assignments.
• negotiate engagement letters, confidentiality agreements and other related documents. Supervise the preparation of marketing materials including information memoranda and management presentations for sell-side processes.
• advise clients on tactical matters. Lead buy- and sell-side due diligence efforts.
• review and negotiate merger agreements and other M&A related legal documents.
• oversee complex financial analyses and modeling related to mergers and acquisitions including accretion/dilution analysis, ability-to-pay analysis, leveraged buyout analysis and valuation analyses like discounted cash-flow analysis, comparable companies analysis, precedent transaction analysis, and sum-of-parts analysis.
• identify potential accounting and tax issues related to mergers and acquisitions. Assess acquisition finance and post-merger/acquisition credit risk, reviewing corporate financial statements and balance sheets.
• prepare and present board materials as well as private and public fairness opinions.

jobs.title: Cross Border Business Risk Specialist
jobs.description:

• implement small changes to the framework, processes or related IT capabilities for GWM APAC
• provide subject-matter-expertise to innovation and digital projects.

jobs.title: Fund Accountant
jobs.description:
Do you have a strong attention to detail that enables robust accounting oversight and sound risk governance? Do you thrive in cross‑functional and multi‑regional environments? Are you a diligent, process‑driven professional with deep fund accounting expertise?
We are looking for a Fund Accountant who will play a key role in overseeing Taiwan fund accounting activities and contributing to regional initiatives.
The successful candidate will:
• Represent Taiwan Fund Accounting at both local and regional levels, and contribute to cross functional and cross regional projects
• Support and oversee fund accounting–related regulatory reporting
• Apply strong technical expertise in NAV calculation and valuation
• Demonstrate a strong risk and control mindset in overseeing fund administration vendors
• Coordinate fund financial statement audits with external auditors
• Manage trade processing, settlement, and related controls, working closely with front and middle offices to resolve trade discrepancies and mitigate operational risks
• Act as a key point of contact for external clients and internal stakeholders, responding to fund accounting–related inquiries in a timely and professional manner
• Ensure all control processes and procedures (e.g., reconciliations, payments) comply with UBS standards, internal policies, and regulatory requirements
• Support and manage fund life‑cycle events, including (but not limited to) fund launches, mergers, liquidations, and fund maturities
• Design and deliver customized reports to meet client and business requirements
• Provide support for APAC cross‑regional initiatives and tasks as required
